start.text: Hey - sorry - do you have UPI? My phone died mid-payment and this uncle thinks I'm running away with his cycle. It's sixty. I'm not a scam. Well. A scam would say that.

broke.text: Flat deposit. Say no more, I've been there. I'll stand here and look honest until the uncle gives up.

again.text: Still here. Still honest. Still sixty.

paid.text: You're a lifesaver. Give me your number - I'll send it back tonight, when this thing remembers it's a phone. (She holds up a very dead screen.) I'm Ananya.

choices.text: Only if I get yours first.

paid_again.text: The sixty-rupee person. Number? For the refund. Purely business.

number_flirt.text: Bold, for someone who just paid for my cycle. (She writes it on your hand. Actual pen.) Now yours.

number.text: Saved. I shoot the park every Sunday - the light under the bamboo at four is unfair. Walking the loop? I'll show you the five spots everyone photographs, and the one nobody does.

choices.text: Another time - I have a bus to catch.

number_done.text: Changed your mind about the loop? Bandstand, bamboo, the library steps. Twenty minutes. I talk the whole way, fair warning.

go.text: Bandstand first. Try to keep up - I've got a cycle.

later.text: Next Sunday, then. I'll be the one arguing with the cycle uncle.

walking.text: Keep walking. Bandstand, then the bamboo, then the library steps. I'll tell you when to stop.

after_walk.text: Same time next Sunday? I'll bring the proper lens. And your sixty rupees. Probably.
